run_video_evaluation: run the single clip evaluation script on the Kinetics dataset with a pretrained ResNet50 3D model
run_evaluation_with_custom_model: run the evaluation script with a custom model checkpoint path and GPU configuration
run_evaluation_with_batch_size: run the video classification evaluation with a specified batch size and frame interval
review_autofill_function: review the autofill function that extracts model prefix and epoch from the model subpath argument
review_set_logger_function: review the set_logger function that configures file and stream logging handlers with debug mode
